name: ghostcall
description: Trustless, untraceable 1:1 audio calls on Starknet. No TURN server. No trusted relay. No IP exposure.

scripts.dev: concurrently "next dev renderer --port 3000" "wait-on http://localhost:3000 && tsc -p tsconfig.json && cross-env NODE_ENV=development electron ."
scripts.build: next build renderer && tsc -p tsconfig.json && electron-builder

author: Philotheephilix
